title: Is Parking Included?
titleZh: 停車費有包含在房價裡嗎？
source: 原創基礎課程：小綠書 U06 情境功能改寫
summaryZh: 在飯店入住時確認停車是否另計、每晚價格與兩晚總額，再決定是否使用。

learning.objectiveZh: 問清住宿附加費是否包含、單晚價格與多晚總額，並明確說出自己的選擇。

vocabulary.en: Money paid for leaving a car in a parking area.
Already part of a price or group.
Added to the main amount or price.
The complete amount after items are added together.
To make sure that information is correct.

task.titleZh: 換個條件：確認早餐加購費
task.setupZh: 你住兩晚。飯店早餐每人每晚十五美元；詢問是否包含、覆述兩晚費用，再決定是否加購。金額是假設練習，不用真實訂房資料。

steps.partner: Would you like to add breakfast to your stay?
steps.promptZh: 詢問早餐費是否已包含在房價裡。
steps.sample: Is breakfast included in the room price?

steps.partner: No. It's fifteen dollars per person per night.
steps.promptZh: 覆述兩晚的早餐費總額，並請對方確認。
steps.sample: So for two nights, the total is thirty dollars?

steps.partner: That's right. Would you like to add it?
steps.promptZh: 決定加購或婉拒，並確認最後帳單會列出這筆費用。
steps.frame: ___ . Please show it on the bill.
steps.sample: I'd like to add it. Please show it on the bill.

success: 我有問清楚費用是否包含。
我有正確覆述單晚／多晚價格並請對方確認。
我有明確說出是否加購。

spokenPractice.noteZh: 核心句已足以問清費用；以下替代說法是選修，不要求第一次全部記住。

alternatives.clear: Is parking included in the room price?
alternatives.natural: Does parking come with the room?
alternatives.guidanceZh: come with 在這裡是「包含在……裡」，適合詢問房價方案。

alternatives.natural: Is that on top of the room rate?
alternatives.guidanceZh: on top of 表示費用要另外加上；先聽懂即可。

alternatives.clear: Please show the fee separately on the bill.
alternatives.natural: Could you itemize that on the bill?
alternatives.guidanceZh: itemize 是請對方逐項列出，語氣較正式。

drill.setupZh: 聽到每晚單價後，先自己算出兩晚金額，再用英文覆述確認。

turns.speaker: 飯店櫃檯
turns.text: It's fifteen dollars per night for two nights.

turns.speaker: 你
turns.text: So the total is thirty dollars?

drill.successZh: 正確覆述總額並以問句確認即可；不必在未提供資訊時猜稅額。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hi. I have a room reservation for two nights.
sentences.zh: 你好，我訂了兩晚的房間。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Welcome. Would you like to use our parking?
sentences.zh: 歡迎。你要使用我們的停車位嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Maybe. Is the parking fee included in the room price?
sentences.zh: 可能會。停車費包含在房價裡嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: No. It's an extra twelve dollars per night.
sentences.zh: 沒有。每晚要另外付十二美元。
sentences.note: extra 與 per night 是判斷費用是否另計及計價方式的關鍵。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: So the total parking fee for two nights is twenty-four dollars?
sentences.zh: 所以停兩晚的停車費總額是二十四美元嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That's right. It will be added to your room bill.
sentences.zh: 沒錯，這筆會加在你的房費帳單之外。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Do I have to decide now?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: No. We can add it after you park.
sentences.zh: 不用。你停好車後我們可以再加。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Okay, I'll use it. Please show the fee separately on the bill.
sentences.zh: 好，我會使用。請在帳單上分開列出這筆費用。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Of course. You can confirm the total before you pay.
sentences.zh: 沒問題。付款前你可以確認總額。

questions.q: Is parking part of the room price?
questions.explanationZh: 櫃檯回答停車費每晚另計。

questions.q: How much is parking for two nights?
questions.explanationZh: 每晚十二美元，兩晚共二十四美元，旅客並向櫃檯覆述確認。

questions.q: When can the guest decide to use parking?
questions.explanationZh: 櫃檯說停好車後仍可再加。
